name: Linares (Spain)
description: Five equal horizontal stripes of yellow, green, white, red and blue.
history: The flag of Linares is rectangular, one and a half times longer than wide, composed of five horizontal stripes of yellow, green, white, red and blue in descending order, all of the same width. According to the historian Federico Ramírez, the origin of this local ensign goes back to a processional journey to the sanctuary of the Virgen de Linarejos in 1666.
